title: De Lima to gov't: Consider declaring Chinese envoy persona non grata

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Mamamayang Liberal Rep. Leila de Lima said Monday that the executive branch should “seriously consider” declaring Chinese Ambassador to the Philippines Jing Quan persona non grata. De Lima told reporters that the Marcos administration has the authority to declare the Chinese envoy unwelcome, saying diplomats must adhere to basic diplomatic decorum while serving in a host country. “I strongly believe that we can… seriously consider actually declaring him persona non grata, especially if he does not take back what he said, his threatening words,” she said.
